question: naming.compiler.original-info-commands-literal-resolution
problem: What original source eligibility, compound opcode recipe, selected command slot, and result/argument object births govern info commands absolute compile-time literals, and where must consumers preserve generic dispatch?
scope: Original providers measured independently. C8.4/8.5 specialised compiler-hook absence is an observed selected-source and executed opcode result; native debug disassembly is unavailable in these non-debug original builds. Jim script tokens are not C Tcl bytecode. Registered-hook inventory is a separate proof. ORIGINAL result, CHILD_BIRTH children and ORIGINAL_ARGUMENT runtime argument headers and resident bytes are captured before their counted string getters. Each compiled-body literal/token header is captured before its own counted string getter. All objects are original and retained live; no private freed headers. Original C8.6+ disassembly follows header capture. No backend pass assertion.
